svg.title: Practice chanter, square bore of four finger-jointed strips, cookies from just above high A, sheet 1 of 1
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Practice chanter, square bore of four finger-jointed strips, cookies from just above high A, sheet 1 of 1. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Orange #ff8000 cuts the bores, seats, finger and pin holes first; then black #000000 frees the plates.
